items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: a friend of mine, Jack Marshall, the guitar player, it was one of his dates.

ctx.x: Yeah. Because I did a record date after that, it was funny, a friend of mine, Jack Marshall, the guitar player, it was one of his dates. And he came over to me and he said, “do you think you could play something like the guy played on the ‘Primrose Lane’ intro?”
